text.p: Following is a summary of major Shanghai political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China plans to issue a record 248.596 billion yuan of domestic state debt in 1997.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China's state planning commission issues a report urging Beijing to curb investment by multi-nationals in large Chinese firms.
- By the end of 1996, Shanghai had 1,835 foreign-invested retail firms with a total investment of $4.445 billion.
- Shanghai has turned 200 big state enterprises into shareholding companies.
- China textile industry is growing more healthily with large textile firms moving to the interior and using high technoloy in production.
